methodology: Eight daily observations over seven days; endpoint log-trend extrapolation at 1, 2, 7, 14 and 30 days. Fixed-basket set indexes use points, not dollar set values. Daily provider releases, not intraday trades. Flat means within ±1% of baseline. Eligible outcomes only; unchanged price is the baseline. Experimental, not investment advice.
